summary: Releases a memory block back into a slab/buddy allocator object (a1). Aligns the requested size a3 to 16 bytes, derives the subbin selector from the block address relative to the region base a1[3], reads the block header at a2-4 (slot count and total span), then either splits an oversized free block into an allocated part plus a free remainder or, when the block is already free, coalesces it with its buddy. The remainder is re-inserted into the free list of its size class while updating the aggregate bitmap words a1[0] (size classes below 0x20) and a1[1] (classes 0x20-0x3F) and the per-subbin bitmap arrays at v3 + 4*v5 + 68 / + 196. Returns 1 on success and 0 when the block is marked in use or the requested size exceeds the total span. Invoked from sub_58B5D4.

local_names.a1: allocator object; a1[0] lower aggregate bitmap word, a1[1] upper aggregate bitmap word, a1[3] region base, a1[4] per-subbin data base
local_names.a2: address of the memory block being released
local_names.v5: subbin selector derived from the block address
local_names.v3/v36: per-subbin data base and per-subbin free-list head area

operations.description: Read the block header at a2-4: v6 = (header size dword) - 1 giving the aligned-slot count, v7 = total span dword at v6 + a2 - 4, with v8 = v6 + a2 - 4 as the free-list node base.
Compute the aligned requested size v4 = (a3 + 23) & 0xFFFFFFF0, the subbin selector v5 = (a2 - a1[3]) >> 15, and the per-subbin head area v36 = 516 * v5 + v3 + 324 where v3 = a1[4].
When v4 <= v6 the request fits within the first header span: take the shrink path and either use the whole block or split off a free remainder of span v44 = v6 - v4.
When v4 > v6, reject with return 0 if the block is marked in use (v7 low bit set) or the request exceeds the total span (v4 > v6 + v7).
Coalesce path: unlink the free block from its current size-class list by relinking the cross-links stored at v8 + 4 and v8 + 8, then merge its span into the buddy region.

Clear the old size class from the per-subbin bitmap (v3 + 4*v5 + 68 for classes below 0x20, v3 + 4*v5 + 196 for classes 0x20-0x3F), decrement the class-count byte at v3 + class + 4, and clear the aggregate bit 0x80000000 >> class in a1[0] (lower) or a1[1] (upper) when the count drops to zero.

Record the remainder's size class: increment the class-count byte, set the class bit in the per-subbin bitmap (v3 + 4*v5 + 68 / + 196), and set the aggregate bit in a1[0] or a1[1] when the class was previously empty.

Finish the free-list insert for the remainder node v25 = a2 + v4 - 4: store next/back links via the head at v33 = v36 + 8*class, and write the remainder size v44 into the node header v25[0] and its trailer.
On the shrink path write the final allocated-block header and trailer: *(_DWORD *)(v21 - 4) = v4 + 1 and *(_DWORD *)(v21 + v4 - 8) = v4 + 1.
Return 1 after a successful release/split; the in-use or over-sized guard returns 0.
This free path is invoked from sub_58B5D4 (0x0058B5D4).
